Description: Work will be performed using the wire fishing method to minimize disruption to finished surfaces while updating the electrical system. Scope includes the removal and replacement of the existing 100-amp subpanel with a like-for-like 100-amp panel to satisfy insurance requirements. A new 100-amp subfeed will be installed from the main panel to the subpanel. A partial rewire will be completed for three bedrooms, the hallway, and selected lighting. All accessible knob-and-tube wiring in these areas will be removed and replaced with modern NM (Romex) cable. All work will be done in compliance with current NEC code and local building standards.
